title: The Malmstrom AFB UFO/Missile Incident (Echo Flight, Mar 16, 1967)

title: 341st Strategic Missile Wing & 341st CSG History, Apr-Jun 1967, Vol 1 (HQ SAC DXIH 67-3922), Echo Flight investigation excerpt (transcription)
author: A2C David E. Gamble, Wing Historian; approved Col. John W. Carroll
organization: USAF/SAC (excerpt published by RR0 from FOIA release)
pages_sections: pp. 33-38 of document (as paginated in excerpt)
extracted_information: At 0845 on 16 Mar 1967 all Echo Flight sites lost strategic alert nearly simultaneously (VRSA channels 9 and 12 No-Go); "normal controlled shutdown"; Engineering Investigation Team report dated 23 Mar 1967; weather ruled out; "Rumors of Unidentified Flying Objects ... were disproven" (Mobile Strike Team checked November Flight LFs, no sightings); 801st Radar Sq negative; E-1 power fluctuation 1453 and commercial power restored 1921 same day; Fergus Electric transformer short at Winifred substation; similar Alpha Flight event 19 Dec 1966; external signals judged "very remote"; further study at contractor facility.
reliability_notes: Transcription is by a third party; original document not examined by me. Wing history compiled by an airman historian; conflicts with Salas/Gamble allegation of alteration are unresolved.

title: Anomalous Echoes Captured by a B-52 Airborne Radarscope Camera: A Preliminary Report
author: Martin Shough
extracted_information: Frame-by-frame description of scans 771-783; quotes Werlich memo ("2½ mile in 3 sec or about 3,000 mi/hr"); reconstructs the "3900" figure as the average of two paint-time-corrected rates (~1,990 kt and ~5,870 kt co-altitude, relative to B-52; ~3,900 kt); notes 3000 mph cannot be recovered from photos; only ~1/10 of original frames survive; tests meteor, AP, multiple-trip, ECM, balloon, aircraft hypotheses; concludes none fully convincing.
reliability_notes: Independent of Tulien/Poher in method but part of the same project; "preliminary"; assumptions (co-altitude, single target, range-scale 5 NM inferred as no scale indicator on photos) stated.

reliability_notes: Poher states the UFO hypothesis ("exceptional UFO case"); only abstract, Part 1 and Appendix 1 portions read by me.

title: Independent measurement of radarscope frames 772-773 (this project)
author: Analyst
extracted_information: Strongest blobs inside the altitude hole: frame 772 at r=111 px, screen angle 124 deg (slant 1.09 NM); frame 773 at r=109 px, 282 deg (1.08 NM); angular separation 158 deg matches Shough; displacement 2.14 NM (Shough 2.06). Frame 771 echo not recovered (overlaps third ring).
reliability_notes: Scans are prints, JPEG-compressed; range calibration assumes rings at 0.75/1.25/1.75 NM; orientation assumed heading-up and constant.
